comparison.note: Positive has one extra DrawIndexed and one extra Draw renderpass compatibility occurrence; these are existing error patterns, not new error types. Equal hazard signatures do not prove all GPU synchronization correct.

confirmedNewBlockingFailure.cause: Temporary overlayContext releases its active m_descPool after recording. allocateDescriptorSet transfers that pool to a command list only when the pool fills; the single overlay dispatch does not fill it.

sourceEvidence.fact: Pool tracking occurs only on allocation exhaustion.

reviewedRootFix.mechanism: Final command list retains CallbackFence, whose callback captures Rc<overlayContext>. endRecording exchanges m_cmd to nullptr to break the ownership cycle. The context/pool survive until GPU fence notification.
reviewedRootFix.requiredNextCheck: Rebuild/repackage, rerun positive and disabled sync validation, require descriptor invalidation to disappear and compare remaining baseline hazards explicitly. Keep strict verifier rejection of Vulkan errors.

approvalLimit: Successful readback/callback is insufficient: positive composition pixels match, but validation reports illegal descriptor lifetime and the disabled offscreen baseline also contains Vulkan errors.
